# 2. Values I would not let through as written

1. **mauler-dedication (3 near-identical rows).** `critSpecWeapons` has no `hands` key — `hands:2` would be dead. The two corrections also give *contradictory measurements* of the pool (227 vs 314 hands-2 items; "45 carry a two-hand-\* trait" vs "exactly ONE"). Author **only `minRank:"expert"`** on the existing entry; re-measure before building `hands` on WeaponFamiliarity. Dedupe the three rows to one.
2. **kaiju-defense-oath (2 rows).** One is additive, one is a `situationalReplaces` array that *restates* the damage clause. Shipping both prints the damage star twice. Ship the replacement array only.
3. **lavasoul (2 rows) — ordering dependency.** The `strikeName` gate is exact lowercase equality, so the grantedStrikes rename must land in the same patch as the strikeDamage and critSpecWeapons rows, or all three are inert.
4. **invulnerable-rager `rankUpgrade [{13,expert},{19,master}]`.** The levels come from the app's barbarian advancement table, not the feat's text, and the field is level-keyed rather than gated on owning medium-armor-expertise — an archetype barbarian is over-granted. See ruling §4.1.
5. **energy-fortification.** Uses `requiresSkillRank` with a `max` bound on six options; I could not confirm `max` is honoured (the 7 shipped rows I know of use `min`). Verify before authoring, or the tiers stack.
6. **psi-cantrips-and-amps `refocusRestore: 2`.** The printed clause is conditional and the field has no condition slot; flat 2 over-grants. Also write-only until `refocusRestore` is declared on ClassFeature *and* the reader stops iterating feats alone.

10. **versatile-mutation.** Only the `distinctAcrossTakes` half is authorable; `picks:2` would wrongly ask the first take for two. Ships 2 of the printed 3 energy types.
11. **silhouette-cloak (medium).** `noStrikes` is an approximation of "no actions except Climb/Step/Stride", and the two resistance rows (20 all / 40 nonmagical) overlap — check the IWR renderer doesn't double-list them.

Already caught by the corrections, restated so they don't slip back in: **crane-stance** (do NOT null grantedStrikes — test/stance-strikes.test.ts asserts it; fix the duplicate render in the engine), **lesser-enhance-venom** (do NOT grant Envenom from the feat — it is an ancestry ability; fix the MainTab walk), **tengu-weapon-familiarity** (do NOT ship the unfiltered picker — `OpenChoiceFrom` has no group filter, so it offers every weapon in inventory), **veil-may** (do NOT invent a "Shed Disguise" action), **dedication-to-the-five** (spellNotes fails test/spell-notes.test.tsx — put it on the feat), **shootist-bandolier** (`recordMarks` is never read for items — code registry only, drop `value`, and do NOT clone to repeater-bandolier, whose printed text differs), **vampire-dedication** (`dataWarning`, not `note` — the record already has a note and backfill writes whole fields), **weapon-proficiency** (snapshot martial rank *before* build.ts:4228 or every wizard is handed a trained advanced weapon on take 1), **disarming-flair** (drop the invented panache clause).

Two more are actionable after a rewrite: **intimidating-prowess** (the +2 upgrade is genuinely missing; the value's `bonus` is 146 chars and nothing trims a `bonus` — split it, and replace the registry line rather than concatenating).

# 4. Needs an owner ruling

1. **The armour-mirror clause — 7 records, one lane or seven notes?** Printed: *"Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat."* Champion-, sentinel-, guardian-dedication, mountain-skin, invulnerable-rager, warpriests-armor, armigers-protection. Five proposals disclose it as a note; invulnerable-rager's instead hard-codes 13/19 from the barbarian table. Inconsistent as a set — rule once: build `armorMirrorBest` on FeatGrant (mirroring the live weapon-side `mirrorBestCategory`), or disclose all seven.
2. **Archetype cantrips: known vs prepared.** Printed (wizard-dedication): *"gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice… You can prepare two cantrips each day from your spellbook."* All four are at-will today. Affects wizard-, magus-, necromancer- (whose own code comment says "Four known, two prepared") and hedge-mage-dedication, and blocks spellshot-dedication's new CASTER_ARCHETYPES entry from being correct. Build the split, or ship 5 notes?
3. **Proficiency-keyed frequencies.** Printed (medic-dedication): *"Once per day, you can use Battle Medicine on a creature that's temporarily immune… If you're a master in Medicine, you can do so once per hour."* LimitedUses has no `perByProficiency`. Ship `day` (under-grants masters, and is what the feat gives at acquisition), or build the field? Same shape recurs on ward-medic and pei-zing-adept, which are being disclosed as marks.
4. **tengu-weapon-familiarity — build or disclose.** Printed: *"During your daily preparations, you can practice with a weapon from the sword group that's in your possession. You gain familiarity with that weapon as well."* Needs `from.group` on OpenChoiceFrom + a daily-choice read in the weaponFromChoiceFlag resolver. Half-building it is an unbounded over-grant.
5. **vampire-dedication — scrape or disclose.** Printed: *"You gain Revulsion and Sunlight vulnerabilities detailed on [sidebar] and the Drink Blood ability."* core.json's `sidebar/vampire-vulnerabilities` (aonId sidebar-1790) is a bare header and core-descriptions.json has no `sidebar` bucket at all. Scrape the sidebar from the mirror first, or ship the dataWarning and leave it?
6. **Items have no rendered note.** 35 items already carry `note` values that appear on no screen; parade-armor's +1 host Bulk and the magical-medals invest exemption both land there. Add an item note surface, or log both as engine gaps and stop authoring item notes?
7. **Two values not taken from the record's own printed text.** ranger-dedication `tradition:'primal'` (the feat prints only *"Your spellcasting attribute is Wisdom"*; primal comes from the ranger class, already asserted at build.ts:2491) and magic-warrior-dedication's 13-animal option list (read from Animal Form's AoN doc, not from this feat). Both look right to me; confirm the sourcing is acceptable.
8. **Repeatable feats with per-take pick counts.** Printed (versatile-mutation): *"You can take this feat a second time at 16th level. When you do, choose two additional energy types…"* FeatChoiceDef has no per-take pick count. Ship 2 of 3, or build it?

# 5. Cross-cutting authoring hazards

- **effect-backfill writes whole fields.** Several `note` targets already hold a note (zombie-dedication, vampire-dedication confirmed) — check before writing, or a working clause is silently deleted. `value: null` means *delete*, which is correct for tactics/limitedUses, spellshifter-dedication/grantsFeats and hold-mark, and wrong for widespread-fascination/maxTakable.
- **`situational` concatenates.** Data can never suppress a shipped FEAT_SITUATIONAL entry — either edit the registry line in place (6 records) or ship `situationalReplaces: true` (4).
- **featGrantsAuto.ts is machine-regenerated** by five scripts; anything hand-authored there must move to HAND_AUTHORED_GRANTS *or* be pinned — but HAND_AUTHORED_GRANTS replaces whole entries, so existing conditionalSkills must be carried forward (red-mantis-assassin-dedication, bright-lion-dedication, creative-prodigy, acrobat-dedication).
- **Marks must not self-name** — markNote/markTooltip prefix the record name.
- **`when` ≤ 120 chars is a hard test; `bonus` is not trimmed by anything** — split long clauses rather than letting a paragraph render inside a list item.
- **Three tests need companion edits**: test/dedication-grants.test.ts (bounty-hunter-dedication row), test/stance-strikes.test.ts (do not touch), test/spell-notes.test.tsx (dedication-to-the-five).
